info.headline: Notify NYC - Traffic Delays - Long Island Expressway (QN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-30-2026 at 07:36 AM.
Due to a vehicle collision, expect extensive eastbound traffic delays on the Long Island Expressway at Grand Avenue in Queens. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
